picks.title: Neutone and Roland want you to design your own AI model — and play it live
picks.excerpt: Roland and Neutone's Project LYDIA is a prototype AI effects pedal that lets musicians build their own custom AI models and perform with them in real time, using 'neural sampling' to transfer the timbre of one sound onto another while preserving a player's dynamics and nuance.
picks.rationale: Novel hardware direction — a real-time, player-trainable AI pedal changes how performers use generative models on stage, not just in the box.

picks.title: ACE Studio 2 review: Next-gen AI features, stone age workflows
picks.excerpt: ACE Studio 2 is an AI-centric DAW built around vocal synthesis (140+ voices and 36 AI virtual instruments) plus generative 'Add a Layer' and 'Music Enhancer' tools. MusicTech finds the next-gen AI capabilities genuinely powerful but hampered by sluggish rendering and rough workflows.
picks.rationale: Hands-on review of an AI vocal-synthesis DAW gives producers a concrete verdict on where the tool actually helps versus where it slows work down.

picks.title: Meaw Chain review: can it make "vibe mixing" a thing?
picks.excerpt: Safari Audio's Meaw Chain uses AI to generate entire plugin/mixing chains from a text prompt, offering producers an accessible route to a finished-sounding mix. MusicTech weighs whether AI-driven 'vibe mixing' is genuinely useful across different skill levels.
picks.rationale: Text-prompt-to-mixing-chain is a directly actionable workflow shift; the review tests whether it holds up for real producers rather than just hype.
